text: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: Heb. in the pride of the wicked he doth persecute
hearts: Heb. souls | and blesseth: Or, the coveteous blesseth himself, he abborreth the Lord
never: Heb. unto generation and generation
deceit: Heb. deceits | vanity: Or, iniquity
are priviley set: Heb. hide themselves
secretly: Heb. in the secret places
He croucheth: Heb. he breaketh himself | by his strong ones: Or, into his strong parts
